name: Tansun Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Tansun Technology Co., Ltd. provides information technology (IT) solutions and services for financial industry customers in China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. It offers services for banks, and provides consulting services using technologies, such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain technology; consulting, includes IT planning, financial business, digital transformation consulting, and data asset management; financial technology, contains credit management and credit cards.
